headline: Lake O north-shore boat locks open daily again
what: The north-shore boat locks closed for low water reopened Oct 28 and now run every day: S-135 5:30am–8:30pm; G-36, S-127 and S-131 5:30am–8pm. Taylor Creek (S-193) has been open since Oct 12.
why: The shortcuts into Okeechobee town, Buckhead Ridge and Lakeport are usable again.
todo: Lock tender: 863-532-8042. Point Chosen swing bridge on Route 2 still limits clearance to 8 ft.

headline: Give the SS United States tow room
dateline: Nov 6–16 · expected departure Nov 9 · Mobile to the Gulf
what: The Coast Guard set a 100-yard moving safety zone around the liner and its tugs from the Mobile River down Mobile Bay into the Gulf. She's to be sunk as a reef off Destin on Nov 12.
why: A 990-ft dead-ship tow will fill the ship channel with little room to maneuver.
todo: Listen on VHF 16 for exact tow times. Permission to enter: COTP Mobile, (251) 266-5888.

headline: Sailing Sisters Regatta at Davis Island YC
dateline: Sat Nov 7 · Davis Island Yacht Club, Tampa
what: A one-day women's regatta with a pursuit-style distance race and drop-mark racing on Hillsborough Bay.
why: Same day the A-Class Catamaran Worlds begin at the same club – a big sailing weekend in Tampa.
todo: Register or read the Notice of Race on Regatta Network; watch from the Davis Islands waterfront.
